labels: One student's temple rests against a seated classmate's shoulder, while the supporting classmate stays upright with both hands visible in the lap.; 한 학생의 관자가 앉은 동급생의 어깨에 닿고 받치는 동급생은 몸을 세운 채 두 손을 무릎 위에 드러낸다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: One student's temple rests against a seated classmate's shoulder, while the supporting classmate stays upright with both hands visible in the lap.
aliases: 한쪽 어깨 기대기
